titleDv: ޤާނޫނު ނަންބަރު 9/2009 (ރައީސުލްޖުމްހޫރިއްޔާގެ މަޤާމުން ކުރީ ރައީސުންގެ ރައްކާތެރިކަމާއި އިސްތިރާހަތު ޤާނޫނު) އަށް ... ވަނަ އިޞްލާޙު ގެނައުމުގެ ބިލު
summary: This bill amends the Former Presidents Protection and Benefit Act (Act No. 9/2009), which sets out the protection and benefits given to former presidents. It rewrites Articles 1(b), 3, 9 and 10, adds provisions to Article 5, and changes the definition in Article 13. It also repeals Article 8 and replaces it with a new Article 8-1 that includes an amount of MVR 25,000. The scans are hard to read, so some details are uncertain. This summary covers the first 12 of 13 pages.
whyItMatters: It changes what benefits a former president can receive and the rules for when they apply or stop, with the sums involved set in the new Article 8-1.
keyProvisions: Clauses 1 and 2 replace Article 1(b) and Article 3(s); the new Article 3(s) refers to the case covered by Article 3(b) and sets out numbered sub-points (1) and (2).
Clause 3 amends Article 5 by adding new paragraphs. The conditions they set could not be read reliably.
Clause 4 repeals Article 8. The comparison table shows the current Article 8 containing a figure of MVR 175,000.

Clause 5 inserts a new Article 8-1. Its paragraph (a)(1) contains an amount of MVR 25,000 (twenty-five thousand rufiyaa). The scans do not make clear whether this replaces the 175,000 figure in old Article 8.
Clauses 6 and 7 replace Article 9(s) and Article 10, and clause 8 amends the definition in Article 13; the text of each could not be read reliably.
The bill is followed by a financial-impact statement listing 2026 figures of MVR 10,500,000, MVR 300,000 and MVR 700,000, but the scan does not make clear what each line covers.
whoIsAffected: Former presidents of the Maldives, and the government bodies that provide and fund their protection and benefits.
statedReasons: A short explanatory note is printed, but the scan is too unclear to summarise it reliably.
